authority_note: Pinned grading data distilled from Broadcom VCF 9.1 release, interoperability, import, and upgrade-path publications. It is intentionally data, not a search-result or fetch fixture.

gate_definitions.MANAGEMENT_DOMAIN_IMMUTABLE: The existing management-domain component is observed only and receives no lifecycle operation.
gate_definitions.NSX_AT_IMPORT_BASELINE: The candidate NSX deployment has reached 4.2 before vCenter and ESXi are remediated.
gate_definitions.VCENTER_UPGRADE_PATH_SUPPORTED: The pinned matrix contains the vCenter source-to-target edge.
gate_definitions.VCENTER_AT_IMPORT_BASELINE: The candidate vCenter has reached 8.0 U3 before its hosts are remediated.
gate_definitions.ESXI_UPGRADE_PATH_SUPPORTED: The pinned matrix contains the ESXi source-to-target edge.
gate_definitions.ALL_HOSTS_AT_IMPORT_BASELINE: Every candidate cluster host has reached 8.0 U3.
gate_definitions.VSAN_UPGRADE_PATH_SUPPORTED: The pinned matrix contains the vSAN source-to-target edge.
gate_definitions.NSX_UPGRADE_PATH_SUPPORTED: The pinned matrix contains the NSX source-to-target edge.
gate_definitions.IMPORT_COMBINATION_SUPPORTED: vCenter 8.0 U3, ESXi/vSAN 8.0 U3, and NSX 4.2 match the pinned VCF 9.1 import combination.
gate_definitions.IMPORT_PRECHECKS_PASS: VCF Operations import prechecks report no blocking findings.
gate_definitions.MANAGEMENT_DOMAIN_UNCHANGED: The import adds the VI workload domain without a management-domain lifecycle action.
